morphology.pattern_note: 按不可作马来语词缀拆分的人名整体处理；is_root 仅表示本条无马来语派生结构。IPA 为常见英语读法，实际读音以本人为准。原包未提供音节划分及 Jawi，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 米丽娅姆；通常用作女性名字，也用于指称《希伯来圣经》中摩西和亚伦的姊妹米利暗。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name, also borne by the biblical sister of Moses and Aaron.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan; juga nama saudara perempuan Musa dan Harun dalam tradisi Bible.
senses.nuances: 按专有名词释读，规范书写为 Miriam。原包没有 DBP 释义，不能标为已核实的正式马来语普通词；马来语释义为说明性编写。搭配为专名使用句式示例，未作词频验证。姓名背景见 [Biblical Archaeology Review：Miriam](https://library.biblicalarchaeology.org/department/whats-in-a-name-miriam/)。

etymology.historical_story: Miriam is an established rendering of the biblical Hebrew name Miryam, borne by the sister of Moses and Aaron. Related forms later spread widely through Jewish and Christian naming traditions. Although popular explanations assign it several attractive meanings, its original derivation remains uncertain. It should therefore be learned as a personal name rather than translated as a settled descriptive expression. [Biblical Archaeology Review](https://library.biblicalarchaeology.org/department/whats-in-a-name-miriam/).
